entities.summary: Warriors, also known as Warrior Cats, is a novel series about the adventures and drama of multiple Clans of feral cats. Warriors is published by HarperCollins and written by a team collectively known as Erin Hunter. The concept of the series was developed by Victoria Holmes, who wrote the storylines until her retirement in 2017.
